title: The handler's last .catch sent the raw error to Sentry when the outer catch threw
evidence: app/lib/discord-bot.server.ts startDiscordBot: handleMessage(message).catch sent Sentry.captureException(err). Reached when the outer catch throws (a throwing getter on name or code). It now sends a DiscordHandleError with fingerprint discord-handle/catch-failed/catch and logs fixed words. Test: a code getter that throws leaves nothing of the error in any Sentry argument or log line. Fable on PR 1397
